housing-numbers.notes: Plan period 2020/21 to 2036/37 (17 years). London Plan sets housing target of 775 per annum and 7,750 by 2028/29. Overall target for full plan period is minimum 13,175 homes. Windfall breakdown: small sites 8,224 (484 per year for 17 years), large sites 1,088 (64 per year for 17 years). Housing trajectory shows total projected completions of 14,029 by 2036/37.
